content.title: Scorbunny Scampers into Pokémon GO’s March Community Day
content.text: Galarian first partner Pokémon Scorbunny is hopping into the spotlight for the Pokémon GO March 2026 Community Day. On Saturday, March 14, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time, Scorbunny will appear more frequently in the wild, burning brighter than ever. Trainers with a touch of luck on their side might even encounter a Shiny Scorbunny or a Scorbunny with a Special Background! This Community Day’s featured attack is the Fire-type Charged Attack Blast Burn. Evolve Raboot (Scorbunny’s Evolution) into the Striker Pokémon, Cinderace, during the event or up to four hours afterward to get a Cinderace that knows Blast Burn. Additionally, starting this Community Day, Cinderace will be able to learn the Charged Attack Pyro Ball. Get fired up for these event bonuses. 1/4 Egg Hatch Distance when Eggs are placed into Incubators during the event period 2× Candy for catching Pokémon 2× Chance for Trainers Level 31 and up to receive Candy XL from catching Pokémon Incense (excluding Daily Adventure Incense) activated during the event will last for three hours Take a few snapshots during Community Day for a surprise! Lure Modules will last for one hour and may attract Scorbunny (from 2:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m.) One additional Special Trade can be made for a maximum of two for the day (from 2:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m.) Trades will require 50% less Stardust (from 2:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m.) Scorching-Hot Research Celebrate Scorbunny with Community Day–themed Field Research and Community Day Special Research. Field Research is focused on catching Scorbunny to earn rewards including Stardust, Ultra Balls, additional encounters with Scorbunny, and more. Community Day Special Research is available for US$1.99 (or the equivalent pricing tier in your local currency). Trainers who complete this research will earn the following rewards. Three encounters with Scorbunny that have a Special Background Additional encounters with Scorbunny One Premium Battle Pass One Rare Candy XL Hop to it, Trainers!
